update.title: Recorded generated outputs with their producing operations
update.summary: Stored each generated file’s descriptor on the successful operation that produced it, then aligned discovery and block mappings across the supported evidence types.

blocks.body:
## Keep outputs beside their provenance

Successful tool operations carry `_outputs` descriptors in their configuration, including the generated file’s path, type, and metadata. Work Report discovers evidence candidates from those descriptors instead of joining through a separate row created for every generated file.

The artifact table remains reserved for material explicitly attached to a Work Report, separating generated outputs from curated evidence.

blocks.description: A successful operation carries the descriptor Work Report uses to discover its generated file.

blocks.body:
## Carry each type through the same vocabulary

Handler configuration identifies which tool operation can produce evidence, the source registry defines how that evidence is captured, and the artifact-to-block map selects its Portfolio Editor presentation. The aligned mappings cover code, terminal output, documents, generated images, audio, and Mermaid diagrams.

The registries still serve different responsibilities; the improvement is that supported types match from discovery through presentation, while unknown or missing outputs remain explicit.
